title: Design an ATM Machine
goal: Simulate ATM deposits and largest-denomination-first withdrawals without partial failed transactions.
strategy: Attempt a withdrawal using a temporary note selection from 500 down to 20. Commit inventory changes only when the whole amount is formed; the mandated greedy rule can fail even if a different combination exists.
